1. Ensure there are no other personnel, reflective objects, or flammable materials nearby during welding. 

2. Ensure the safety clamp is securely fastened to the welding table; do not clamp the safety lock onto the welding torch holder, nozzle, wire feed assembly, etc. 

3. Ensure you wear professional protective eyewear, a mask, earplugs, and high-temperature resistant gloves. 

4. When installing and debugging the equipment, always switch the laser to the off position after laser operation. 

5. Ensure the equipment is properly grounded; interruption at any point in the grounding circuit may result in personal injury. 

6. Ensure the filter is well-ventilated; promptly remove any foreign objects or dirt.
